Menu.Name: LucD20 Automations
Menu.Label: Open LucD20 Automations
Menu.Hint: Every LucD20 feature and its options, organized by category.

Hub.Title: LucD20 Automations
Hub.Enable: Turn this feature on or off
Hub.Reset: Reset this feature's options to their defaults
Hub.ResetContent: Reset all options of {name} to their defaults? Its on/off switch is not changed.
Hub.ReloadContent: Some changes only take effect after a reload. Reload now?
Hub.ScopeWorld: World: set by the GM for everyone
Hub.ScopeClient: Per player: each user has their own value
Hub.LegendClient: Per player (each user sets their own)

Error.FeatureStart: LucD20 Automations: {name} failed to start. See the console (F12) for details.
Error.NoGM: This needs a GM to be connected.

combat.Label: Combat
combat.Hint: Turn markers, turn announcements and post-combat loot.

chat.Label: Chat
chat.Hint: Pinned messages and the damage log.

tokens.Label: Tokens & Placement
tokens.Hint: Editing several tokens at once and placing actors on the map.

vision.Label: GM Vision
vision.Hint: How the map looks to the GM.

sheets.Label: Sheets & Windows
sheets.Hint: Actor sheets and window title bars.

doors.Label: Doors
doors.Hint: Door icon size, secret doors and locked doors.

scenes.Label: Scenes & Sound
scenes.Hint: Scene navigation, scene background colors and hidden track names.

playerSettings.Label: Player Settings
playerSettings.Hint: Defaults and locks for players' own settings, for any module.

exploration.Label: Exploration
exploration.Hint: PF2e Search automation and hazard detection.

dnd4e.Label: D&D 4e
dnd4e.Hint: D&D 4e combat automation (merged from D&D 4e Combat Automation).

turnMarker.Name: Turn Marker
turnMarker.Hint: A rotating marker under the token whose turn it is. Its size follows the token's size. Only shown on tokens you can see. Switching it on turns off Foundry's own turn marker (and back on when switched off).

image.Name: Image
image.Hint: Image or video. Built-in markers are in modules/lucd20-automations/assets/markers.

scale.Name: Size beyond the token
scale.Hint: 0 = same size as the token, 0.2 = 20% larger. A 2×2 token gets a marker twice as big.

followArtScale.Name: Follow token art scale
followArtScale.Hint: Also grow with the token's art scale (e.g. PF2e Scale 2).

above.Name: Draw above tokens
above.Hint: Use if the marker doesn't show under tokens.

nextTurnMarker.Name: Next-Turn Marker
nextTurnMarker.Hint: A marker under the combatant who acts next (skips defeated). Never shown on tokens players can't see.

image.Name: Image
image.Hint: Leave empty to use the Turn Marker image (with the color and opacity below).

scale.Name: Size beyond the token
scale.Hint: 0 = same size as the token, 0.2 = 20% larger. A 2×2 token gets a marker twice as big.

followArtScale.Name: Follow token art scale
followArtScale.Hint: Also grow with the token's art scale (e.g. PF2e Scale 2).

above.Name: Draw above tokens
above.Hint: Use if the marker doesn't show under tokens.

matchTurnMarker.Name: Same size and speed as the Turn Marker
matchTurnMarker.Hint: Only the image, color and opacity differ. Turn off to set them separately.

turnAnnouncer.Name: Turn Announcer
turnAnnouncer.Hint: A chat card at each turn with the token image, name, player and round, and a divider when a new round starts. Hidden combatants are skipped. Players get a heads-up when they're up next.

announceRounds.Name: Announce new rounds
announceRounds.Hint: A thin "Round X" divider in chat when a new round starts.

headsUp.Name: "You're up next" notification
headsUp.Hint: An on-screen notification when your character acts next.

lootPile.Name: Loot Pile
lootPile.Hint: When combat ends, review the gear of NPCs marked as defeated and drop it as one loot pile at the centre of the bodies. Double-click the pile to take items or send them to the Party Stash.

announce.Name: Announce in chat
announce.Hint: "Alice took Longsword" when an item is taken.

chatPins.Name: Chat Pins
chatPins.Hint: Right-click a message to pin it (GM only). Pinned messages get an outline, survive Clear Chat and are listed in the pin window next to Export Chat Log.

showToPlayers.Name: Players see pin outlines
showToPlayers.Hint: Only the GM can pin and open the pin list either way.

damageLog.Name: Damage Log
damageLog.Hint: A Damage Log toggle next to the chat buttons shows every HP change: damage, healing, temporary HP and max HP. Players only see tokens whose HP bar they can see.

showToPlayers.Name: Players can open it
showToPlayers.Hint: Players only see tokens whose HP bar they can see.

causeToPlayers.Name: Players see the cause
causeToPlayers.Hint: The system's damage message (e.g. resistances applied).

details.Name: Show what caused it
details.Hint: Attach PF2e's "damage applied" message: damage taken, resistances, weaknesses, immunities, shield block.

multiTokenEdit.Name: Multi-Token Edit
multiTokenEdit.Hint: With several tokens selected, right-click one and use the gears button: its Token Configuration opens, and the fields you change are applied to every selected token.

folderDrop.Name: Folder Drop
folderDrop.Hint: Drop an actor folder (or a PF2e party; hold Alt for the party token) on the map to place every actor at once, randomly or one by one.

placement.Name: Placement
placement.Hint: Ask shows a window on every drop.

hidden.Name: Drop as hidden
hidden.Hint: Default for the window's checkbox (or always, when not asking).

gmVision.Name: GM Vision Mode
gmVision.Hint: Selecting a token keeps the whole map visible, with darkness lifted. Ctrl+G toggles real vision. The Lighting controls icon shows a lit bulb while it is on. In PF2e this drives the system's own GM vision.

brightness.Name: Darkness brightness
brightness.Hint: 1 = PF2e's GM vision look. Lower keeps scenes darker, higher lifts darkness further.

outOfSightOutlines.Name: Out-of-Sight Outlines
outOfSightOutlines.Hint: While you look through tokens (GM Vision off), tokens you can't currently see are shown as a dashed outline colored by disposition, so you still know where they are.

cleanTitleBars.Name: Clean Title Bars
cleanTitleBars.Hint: In every window, title-bar buttons show only their icon; hover for the name. The window title stays.

diceStats.Name: Dice Stats
diceStats.Hint: Roll statistics for everyone, for this session and all time, opened from the bottom of the Actors tab. PF2e checks are split by type and degree of success. Blind and secret rolls only count in the GM's view.

askNewSession.Name: Ask to start a new session when the GM joins
askNewSession.Hint: Yes clears the Session counts; All time is kept.

forceSettings.Name: Force Player Settings
forceSettings.Hint: Set a default or lock any per-player setting (ours, other modules', Foundry's own) for all players. Use the lock button next to a per-player setting, here or in Foundry's Configure Settings. GMs are never affected.

searchAutomation.Name: Search Automation
searchAutomation.Hint: Search spots for hidden doors, clues and Theater of Mind. Place them with the tool button in the Token controls; characters Searching in exploration (PF2e party sheet) roll a secret Perception check when their token enters one.

pause.Name: Pause the game on a find

pan.Name: Pan everyone's camera to the find

gmCard.Name: Private chat card for the GM
gmCard.Hint: Who found it, the rolls, the DC and your note.

hazardDetection.Name: Hazard Detection
hazardDetection.Hint: Hazard tokens notice Searching characters within a range that walls block, measured from the token's edge. Opening a door extends it. Every Searching character then rolls, even outside the area. Set each hazard from its token menu.

autoEnable.Name: On for every hazard token
autoEnable.Hint: Off: only hazards you switch on in their token menu.

defaultRange.Name: Default range (feet)
defaultRange.Hint: Measured from the hazard token's edge. 0 = unlimited (only walls stop it).

nonSearching.Name: Non-Searching characters also roll
nonSearching.Hint: Only for hazards without a minimum proficiency (older Core Rulebook p. 520).

showAreas.Name: Show hazard areas to the GM
showAreas.Hint: Ctrl+H hides or shows them on your screen.

headerButtons.Name: Always Show Header Buttons
headerButtons.Hint: Moves chosen items from a window's ⋮ menu into its title bar as icons, and adds Configure Ownership to older-style sheets.

extras.Name: Other ⋮ items
extras.Hint: Names of other ⋮ menu items to show in the title bar, separated by commas. Example: 3D Dice Settings, View Token Artwork

hudCombatLock.Name: Lock Combat Toggle
hudCombatLock.Hint: The Token HUD's combat button can add tokens to combat but not remove them, so nobody loses their initiative by accident. Remove combatants from the combat tracker, or Shift+click the button (GM).

combatTrackerWindow.Name: Combat Tracker Window
combatTrackerWindow.Hint: When an encounter is created, the combat tracker pops out at the bottom right, next to the sidebar. Players only get it once they can see a combatant.

closeOnEnd.Name: Close when the combat ends
closeOnEnd.Hint: Only if it was opened automatically.

encounterVisibility.Name: Hidden Until Started
encounterVisibility.Hint: Combatants whose token is hidden are added hidden in the combat tracker, so players don't see what's coming. Revealing the token reveals its combatant.

defeatAutomation.Name: Defeat at 0 HP
defeatAutomation.Hint: When an NPC in combat drops to 0 HP, it is marked defeated and gets the defeated status. Player characters are never touched.

hideToken.Name: Hide the token
hideToken.Hint: Hide the NPC's token as soon as it goes down, so bodies don't clutter the map. Loot Pile still finds it.

undoOnHeal.Name: Undo when healed
undoOnHeal.Hint: Healed above 0 HP: no longer defeated, and the token is shown again if this feature hid it.

combatMovement.Name: Combat Movement
combatMovement.Hint: During combat, players can only move the token whose turn it is; tokens not in the combat move freely. A button in the combat tracker header switches between turn order and free movement.

describe.Name: Describe
describe.Hint: Select text anywhere and right-click → Describe, or type /describe Text in chat: everyone sees it on a dark band across the screen for a few seconds. The GM can pause or close it for everyone.

pauseNotifier.Name: Paused Movement Notice
pauseNotifier.Hint: When a player tries to move a token while the game is paused, "Game's Paused" floats up from the token instead of Foundry's notification. Everyone who can see the token sees it.

statusHighlight.Name: Active Effect Highlight
statusHighlight.Hint: Active effects get a colored border and glow in the Token HUD's status effects palette.

sceneNavigation.Name: Scene Navigation
sceneNavigation.Hint: Scenes sidebar: left-click a scene to view it (settings stay in the right-click menu) and a compass icon toggles its navigation entry. The navigation bar collapses during combat.

navToggle.Name: Navigation toggle
navToggle.Hint: A compass icon on each scene: bright when it shows in the navigation bar.

collapseInCombat.Name: Collapse the navigation bar during combat

scenePalette.Name: Scene Palette
scenePalette.Hint: Five color swatches taken from the level's background image, next to the Background color picker in the scene's settings.

hiddenTrackNames.Name: Hidden Track Names
hiddenTrackNames.Hint: Players see "Unknown track" instead of track names in the Playlists sidebar. An eye icon on each track lets the GM reveal its name. Playlist names stay visible.

riding.Name: Riding
riding.Hint: Mark a token Rideable in its Token HUD. Select your token, target the mount and press M: your token rides it (half size, its vision from the mount's centre) until you press M again. Players mount their own tokens from within 1 square.

tokenScatter.Name: Token Scatter
tokenScatter.Hint: Overlapping tokens spread apart a little on screen (flying ones too), so each can be seen, clicked and targeted. Their real positions don't change.

spread.Name: Spread
spread.Hint: How far overlapping tokens move apart (fraction of a square).

ignoreDead.Name: Leave defeated tokens alone
ignoreDead.Hint: Dead, dying or unconscious tokens don't spread.

tokenTooltip.Name: Token Tooltip
tokenTooltip.Hint: Hover a token to see a small panel of values next to it (HP, AC, saves, speeds, distance …). Starts from your system's defaults; each value shows only to who should see it.

pathfinding.Name: Pathfinding
pathfinding.Hint: Dragging a token routes it around walls along the cheapest path, avoiding difficult terrain and squares next to enemies when there's a better way. Hold Q while dragging to ignore enemies, T to ignore terrain. Toggle it in the Token controls.

avoidTerrain.Name: Avoid difficult terrain
avoidTerrain.Hint: Regions with a movement cost count what they cost. Hold T while dragging to ignore.

avoidThreats.Name: Avoid squares next to enemies
avoidThreats.Hint: Squares next to a visible enemy cost extra (no reach or reaction checks). Hold Q while dragging to ignore.

exploredOnly.Name: Players: explored areas only
exploredOnly.Hint: Players' routes only go through explored or visible areas, so they can't reveal the map.

doorIconSize.Name: Door Icon Size
doorIconSize.Hint: Door icons scale with the grid, so they don't get tiny when you zoom out.

factor.Name: Size
factor.Hint: 1 = Foundry's size at a 100 px grid.

secretDoorHighlight.Name: Secret Doors
secretDoorHighlight.Hint: Secret door icons get a thin purple ring and a small eye-slash badge, so they can't be mistaken for normal doors.

confirmOpen.Name: Ask before opening
confirmOpen.Hint: Clicking a closed secret door asks first, so a misclick doesn't spoil the surprise.

lockedDoorAlert.Name: Locked Door Alert
lockedDoorAlert.Hint: When a player clicks a locked door, the chat says who tried it (at most once every 10 seconds per player and door). Hovering the message highlights the door.

lockOptions.Name: Lock options
lockOptions.Hint: Wall settings get a Lock section (description, Force Open, Pick a Lock, other check). Clicking such a door posts a card with buttons to try, and the best party member for each.

autoUnlock.Name: Unlock on success
autoUnlock.Hint: A successful try unlocks the door. Force Open also opens it, and on a plain success breaks it (it becomes secret so it can't be closed).

flyingTokens.Name: Flying Tokens
flyingTokens.Hint: Tokens above elevation 0 hover gently and cast a soft round shadow on the ground, further away the higher they fly.

dnd4eClassFeatures.Name: Class features
dnd4eClassFeatures.Hint: Hunter's Quarry, Warlock's Curse, rages, marks and other class, race and feat rules, applied when powers are used.

quarry.Name: Automate Hunter's Quarry
quarry.Hint: Using Hunter's Quarry tags the nearest visible enemy (or your target) and offers the extra damage in the damage dialog, once per turn.

curse.Name: Automate Warlock's Curse
curse.Hint: Using Warlock's Curse tags the nearest visible enemy (or your target) and offers the extra damage in the damage dialog, once per turn. Star Pact warlocks get Fate of the Void when a cursed enemy drops.

rage.Name: Automate Barbarian rages
rage.Hint: Using a rage power puts the barbarian in that rage until the end of the encounter (ending the previous one) and offers rage-dependent damage bonuses.

marks.Name: Automate marks
marks.Hint: Powers like Misdirected Mark apply the mark to hit targets. Marks use the system's mark status, so the -2 penalty is applied by the dnd4e system.

warnNotNearest.Name: Warn when the target isn't the nearest enemy
warnNotNearest.Hint: For Hunter's Quarry and Warlock's Curse.

primeShot.Name: Prime Shot
primeShot.Hint: +1 to ranged attack rolls for characters with Prime Shot when no ally is nearer to the target.

classFeatures.Name: Class, racial and feat rules
classFeatures.Hint: Bloodhunt (+1 racial vs bloodied foes), Defensive Mobility (+2 AC vs opportunity attacks), Shadow Walk (concealment after moving 3 squares), Rampage (free melee basic attack after a critical hit) and Words of Friendship (+5 to the next Diplomacy check).

tempHpFeatures.Name: Temporary HP features
tempHpFeatures.Hint: Rageblood Vigor (automatic when your attack drops an enemy), Half-Orc Resilience (automatic the first time you are bloodied in an encounter) and Virtue of Valor (card for the bard when an ally within 5 squares bloodies or drops an enemy).

conditionalRiders.Name: Conditional damage and roll riders
conditionalRiders.Hint: Infernal Wrath rolls its fire damage; Dire Radiance deals its extra damage when the target moves closer; Elven Accuracy rerolls your last attack; Fox's Cunning and Fate of the Void add their bonus to the next attack.

powerRiders.Name: Power riders on hit
powerRiders.Hint: Apply Vicious Mockery, Dreadful Word, Curse of the Dark Dream and Stirring Shout to hit targets (with attack/defense penalties), heal allies who hit a Stirring Shout target, and offer Great Cleave's extra damage.

dnd4eCover.Name: Cover
dnd4eCover.Hint: Compute cover and superior cover (corner-to-corner lines) and tick them in the attack dialog. Area attacks are not automated.

preview.Name: Cover preview lines
preview.Hint: While you target a token, draw the cover lines from your token. Only you see them.

dnd4eActionTracker.Name: Action tracker
dnd4eActionTracker.Hint: Track standard, move, minor, immediate and opportunity actions per turn. Using a power spends its action (with trades). Shows pips in the Combat Tracker.

autoMoveActions.Name: Moving a token spends move actions
autoMoveActions.Hint: On a combatant's own turn, dragging its token spends a move action (walk speed per move action, shift speed for shifts; standard actions are traded when needed). Teleports, undo, charges and GM-dragged player tokens are ignored.

panel.Name: Open the action panel in combat
panel.Hint: Open the floating action panel automatically when a combat starts.

warnings.Name: Warn on overspent actions
warnings.Hint: Show a warning when an action is used that isn't available (the action still goes through).

dockPips.Name: Action pips on Combat Tracker Dock
dockPips.Hint: Show the action pips on each portrait of the Combat Tracker Dock module, if it is active.

dnd4eOpportunity.Name: Opportunity attacks
dnd4eOpportunity.Hint: When an enemy leaves a square adjacent to a creature without shifting, or makes a ranged/area attack next to it, whisper a chat card to that creature's controller with a button for the opportunity attack.

dnd4eTriggeredPowers.Name: Triggered powers
dnd4eTriggeredPowers.Hint: Offer powers with a Trigger (Elven Accuracy, Fox's Cunning, Furious Assault, Swift Charge, Infernal Wrath, and any power or monster power with a similar trigger) as a whispered chat card when the trigger happens.

dnd4eDamageApply.Name: Damage application
dnd4eDamageApply.Hint: Damage cards get buttons that apply damage to the targets of the original attack (players' clicks are applied by the GM), to the selected tokens, and a Retarget button.

dnd4eClickMovement.Name: Click-to-move & charge
dnd4eClickMovement.Hint: Highlight the squares for shifts and push / pull / slide, then click to move. Hit riders open automatically after the roll; skipping leaves a button in chat.

dnd4eReadableRolls.Name: Readable rolls & skill checks
dnd4eReadableRolls.Hint: Replace the roll variables in chat (@wepAttack, @powerMod...) with labels and values, and show the module's automatic modifiers.

dnd4eSheetHighlights.Name: Sheet highlights
dnd4eSheetHighlights.Hint: Colour defences changed by temporary effects (red = penalty, green = bonus) and list the effects in their tooltip.

dnd4ePowerSymbols.Name: Power symbols
dnd4ePowerSymbols.Hint: Show the ◆ automation and ■ translation level next to power names in sheets and chat cards. The GM can click a symbol to set it.

dnd4eTokenBadges.Name: Token badges
dnd4eTokenBadges.Hint: Show a large coloured badge with the source's portrait on the top-right of marked tokens.

dnd4eMonsterTexts.Name: Monster texts
dnd4eMonsterTexts.Hint: File with replacement text for monsters (name, powers, description). Import it in a new world to bring them all at once. Text only: numbers stay the compendium's.

dnd4eGameLanguage.Name: 4e game language
dnd4eGameLanguage.Hint: Language for the dnd4e system (abilities, skills, conditions, sheet labels) and this module, independent of Foundry's interface language. Strings missing from the translation stay in Foundry's language. Requires reload.

dnd4eSkillChallenge.Name: Skill Challenges
dnd4eSkillChallenge.Hint: Run a skill challenge at the table: click a character and a skill, the player rolls, and the module judges the roll against the DC and counts successes and failures. Challenges are journal pages; open them from the Skill Challenges button at the bottom of the Journal tab. Players get a window with the skills, their descriptions and a difficulty word, and can roll from it. They never see a DC.

playersSeeProgress.Name: Players see progress by default
playersSeeProgress.Hint: For challenges that don't say so themselves: on = each check's result and the tally go to chat for everyone; off = secret, results are whispered to the GM. Can be switched per challenge in its window.

ForceSettings.Empty: No forced settings yet. Click the lock button next to any per-player setting, here or in Foundry's Configure Settings.

Tooltip.none: Not forced. Click to force this for players.
Tooltip.default: Default for players (they can change it). Click to edit.
Tooltip.lock: Locked for players. Click to edit.
Tooltip.Shortcuts: (Shift+click: Default · Ctrl+click: Locked · again to undo)

default.Label: Default
default.Hint: Applied once to every player; they can change it afterwards.

lock.Label: Locked
lock.Hint: Always your value; players see it greyed out and can't change it.

ChatPins.Empty: No pinned messages. Right-click a chat message and choose Pin Message.
ChatPins.UnpinArchived: Unpin (this message was cleared from chat, so it will be deleted)
ChatPins.FlushKept: {count} pinned message(s) will be kept in Pinned Messages.

MultiTokenEdit.Banner: Editing {count} tokens: the fields you change are applied to all of them.

random.Label: Random
random.Hint: Scattered around where you dropped, never inside walls.

select.Label: Select places
select.Hint: Click on the map to place each actor in turn.

FolderDrop.PanelHint: Click the map to place the highlighted actor. Click a name to place it instead. Right-click or Esc to stop.

DamageLog.Title: Damage Log
DamageLog.ClearContent: Delete every entry in the Damage Log?

DiceStats.Title: Dice Stats
DiceStats.NewSessionContent: Start a new session? The Session dice stats are cleared; All time is kept.

GMVision.KeybindingHint: Switch between the full map with lifted darkness and real token vision.

LootPile.ReviewHint: Uncheck anything that shouldn't be in the pile. Checked items are moved off the NPCs.
LootPile.Failed: Could not create the loot pile. See the console (F12).
LootPile.NoCharacter: You have no character, so you can't take items yourself. You can still send them to the Party Stash.
LootPile.TakeHint: Take for the character above (Shift+click: the whole stack)
LootPile.StashHint: Send to Party Stash (Shift+click: the whole stack)
LootPile.Disabled: The Loot Pile feature is switched off.
LootPile.StashAllContent: Send all {count} item(s) in this pile to the Party Stash?
LootPile.TakeDisabled: You need a character to take items
LootPile.EmptySub: Everything has been taken or stashed.

Search.Speaker: Search

Field.rangeHint: From the token's edge; 0 = unlimited. Walls block it.
Field.label: Name
Field.notePlaceholder: Shown in your private chat card when it's found.

Search.NobodyToRoll: Nobody is Searching (or everyone already failed).
Search.PlaceHint: Drag on the map to draw the search spot (or click for one square). Right-click or Esc to cancel.
Search.ManagerHint: Hazards and search spots on this scene. The dice button rolls for every Searching character now (Theater of Mind).
Search.ResetAllDone: Search reset for every spot on this scene.
Search.NoSpots: No hazards or search spots here.
Search.NoSpotsSub: Place a search spot, or add a hazard with a Stealth DC.
Search.NobodyRolledYet: Nobody has rolled for this yet.
Search.Forget: Remove: this character can search here again
Search.ToggleAreasHint: Hide the hazard detection outlines on your screen; press again to show them.

HudCombatLock.Blocked: Remove combatants from the combat tracker.
HudCombatLock.BlockedGM: Remove combatants from the combat tracker, or Shift+click to remove anyway.

CombatMovement.Turn: Movement: turn order (only the current combatant can move)

SceneNavigation.InNav: Shown in the navigation bar (click to hide)
SceneNavigation.NotInNav: Not in the navigation bar (click to show)

HiddenTrackNames.Hidden: Name hidden from players (click to reveal)
HiddenTrackNames.Revealed: Name shown to players (click to hide)

Describe.Usage: Usage: /describe Text to show on everyone's screen

Doors.SecretConfirm: This is a secret door. Open it?

DoorLocks.ConfigHint: Ways to open this door when it is locked. Players who click it get a card with these options.
DoorLocks.NoOne: No one in the party can try this
DoorLocks.Gone: This door is no longer here.
DoorLocks.NoCharacter: You have no character to try this with.
DoorLocks.ResultBroken: {name} forces the door open. It's broken.
DoorLocks.ResultJammed: {name} jams the door: −2 to Force Open it from now on.
DoorLocks.ResultPicked: {name} picks the lock. The door is unlocked.
DoorLocks.ResultUnlocked: {name} gets past the lock. The door is unlocked.

Riding.KeyHint: Select your token and target a Rideable token to mount it; press again with the rider selected to get off.
Riding.Blocked: Riding: press M to get off
Riding.SelectFirst: Select the token that should ride first.
Riding.TargetFirst: Target a Rideable token, then press M.
Riding.MountIsRiding: That token is riding something itself.
Riding.TooFar: {name} is too far away to mount.
Riding.RideableOff: Not rideable (click to make it Rideable)

TokenTooltip.EditorHint: Value: a data path, text with {…} blocks (@path reads a value; helpers like hp(@attributes.hp) on the Helpers tab), or a script with return. Empty values hide the row.
TokenTooltip.SelectToken: Select a token to browse its data.
TokenTooltip.NoRows: No rows yet. Add one, import, or reset to the defaults.
TokenTooltip.PreviewHint: Preview on the selected token (— = hidden)
TokenTooltip.BrowserHint: Click to insert into the row you're editing.
TokenTooltip.ImportHint: Paste a Token Tooltip Alt export (its Data Manager JSON). Its lists per GM/player, disposition and actor type are merged into rows here; this replaces the rows in the editor (nothing is saved until you click Save).
TokenTooltip.ImportEmpty: No rows found in that export.
TokenTooltip.Imported: Imported {count} rows. Check them, then Save.
TokenTooltip.ResetConfirm: Replace the rows in the editor with this system's defaults? Nothing is saved until you click Save.
TokenTooltip.HelpersHint: Click to insert into the row you're editing. The arrow shows the result on the selected token.

Helper.hp: HP: value, "(temp)" when there is temp HP, Ø at 0.
Helper.hpStatus: Healthy / Grazed / Bloodied / Critical / Ø (good for players on NPCs).
Helper.dc: A modifier as a DC (+10). Hidden when missing.
Helper.speed: PF2e: a speed (land, fly, swim, climb, burrow). Hidden when the creature doesn't have it.
Helper.fraction: value/max of anything with a value and a max.
Helper.distance: Distance from your token, rounded up.
Helper.ternary: Show something only when a condition holds ("" hides the row).
Helper.script: A JavaScript function body: token, actor, data, _token.

DnD4e.Migrated: D&D 4e Combat Automation's data moved into LucD20 Automations: {texts} monster texts, {levels} power marks, {switches} switches, {docs} actors / effects / tokens / combatants / messages. You can disable the old module.
DnD4e.MigrationFailed: LucD20 Automations: moving D&D 4e Combat Automation's data failed (see the console, F12). It will try again on the next load.

SkillChallenge.Title: Skill Challenges
SkillChallenge.Speaker: Skill Challenge
SkillChallenge.EmptyHint: A challenge is a journal page (in the world or in a compendium) with skill challenge data.
SkillChallenge.ResetContent: Clear all progress of {name}? Its successes, failures and log are deleted.
SkillChallenge.NoCharacters: No player characters in this world.
SkillChallenge.DCStep: The DC changes by {step} each time this skill is used.

Does.bonus: A success gives {value} to the next check and doesn't count as a success.
Does.cancelFailure: A success cancels 1 failure and doesn't count as a success.
Does.none: A success doesn't count as a success in the challenge.

Effect.Spent: This skill can't give more successes

SkillChallenge.Asked: The GM asks for a {skill} check from {actor}.
SkillChallenge.SecretHint: Secret: results and the tally are whispered to the GM. Click to let players see them.
SkillChallenge.OpenHint: Each result and the tally go to chat for everyone (never a DC). Click to make it secret.
SkillChallenge.Missing: This challenge's journal page can't be found.
SkillChallenge.EditLocked: Compendium pages can't be edited here (edit the source, or import the journal into the world).
SkillChallenge.ModHint: Added to the next roll when it is judged (a penalty for a bad approach, a bonus for a good idea or a bribe). Back to 0 after one check. Players don't see it.

PlayerRolls.On: Players can roll from their window. Click to call for every check yourself.
PlayerRolls.Off: Only you call for checks. Click to let players roll from their window.

Hide.Hidden: Hidden from players. Click to show it in their window.

Editor.Title: Edit challenge
Editor.Name: Name
Editor.PlayerRolls: Players can roll from their window
Editor.Hints: Show players a difficulty word (Easy, Hard …)
Editor.OutcomeHint: Goes to the GM first; "Show players" makes it public.
Editor.MaxHint: Maximum successes (or successful uses) from this skill. 0 = no limit.
Editor.DCStepHint: Added to the DC after each use of this skill.

Effects.bonus: A bonus to the next check

Editor.BonusHint: Size of the bonus to the next check.
Editor.PenaltyHint: A failed check gives this penalty to the next check.
Editor.BonusSkillsHint: Skill keys, separated by commas (e.g. stl, ath). Empty = the next check, whatever the skill.
Editor.DifficultyHint: What players see instead of the DC. Automatic = worked out from the DC and the challenge's level.
Editor.CountsFailure: A failed check is a failure
Editor.StagesHint: Parts completed in order, each after its number of successes (the last takes what is left).
Editor.StageSkillsHint: Skill keys that belong to this stage: others get the penalty automatically. Empty = you decide per check with the "Wrong stage" button.
Editor.ThresholdsHint: Text shown to the GM when failures reach a number.
Editor.GroupChecksHint: Ready-made group checks for the runner's Group check button.
Editor.RoutesHint: Alternative paths that change skills. A list like [{ "name": "Front gate", "note": "…", "skills": [{ "skill": "stl", "dc": 15 }] }]. See docs/skill-challenge.md.
Editor.RoutesInvalid: Routes: that isn't a valid JSON list.
Editor.SaveFailed: The challenge could not be saved.

enableQuarry.Name: Automate Hunter's Quarry
enableQuarry.Hint: Using Hunter's Quarry tags the nearest visible enemy (or your target) and offers the extra damage in the damage dialog, once per turn.

enableCurse.Name: Automate Warlock's Curse
enableCurse.Hint: Using Warlock's Curse tags the nearest visible enemy (or your target) and offers the extra damage in the damage dialog, once per turn. Star Pact warlocks get Fate of the Void when a cursed enemy drops.

enableRage.Name: Automate Barbarian rages
enableRage.Hint: Using a rage power puts the barbarian in that rage until the end of the encounter (ending the previous one) and offers rage-dependent damage bonuses.

enableMarks.Name: Automate marks
enableMarks.Hint: Powers like Misdirected Mark apply the mark to hit targets. Marks use the system's mark status, so the -2 penalty is applied by the dnd4e system.

enableCover.Name: Automatic cover
enableCover.Hint: Compute cover and superior cover (corner-to-corner lines) and tick them in the attack dialog. Area attacks are not automated.

warnNotNearest.Name: Warn when the target isn't the nearest enemy
warnNotNearest.Hint: For Hunter's Quarry and Warlock's Curse.

coverPreview.Name: Cover preview lines
coverPreview.Hint: While you target a token, draw the cover lines from your token. Only you see them.

preloadIndexes.Name: Preload compendium indexes
preloadIndexes.Hint: Load compendium indexes in the background when the game starts, so the first character sheet you open doesn't stall for a few seconds.

debug.Name: Debug logging
debug.Hint: Write diagnostic messages to the browser console.

gameLanguage.Name: 4e game language
gameLanguage.Hint: Language for the dnd4e system (abilities, skills, conditions, sheet labels) and this module, independent of Foundry's interface language. Strings missing from the translation stay in Foundry's language. Requires reload.

actionTracker.Name: Action Tracker
actionTracker.Hint: Track standard, move, minor, immediate and opportunity actions per turn. Using a power spends its action (with trades). Shows pips in the Combat Tracker.

actionPanel.Name: Open the action panel in combat
actionPanel.Hint: Open the floating action panel automatically when a combat starts.

actionWarnings.Name: Warn on overspent actions
actionWarnings.Hint: Show a warning when an action is used that isn't available (the action still goes through).

tokenBadges.Name: Quarry/curse/mark badges on tokens
tokenBadges.Hint: Show a large coloured badge with the source's portrait on the top-right of marked tokens.

dockPips.Name: Action pips on Combat Tracker Dock
dockPips.Hint: Show the action pips on each portrait of the Combat Tracker Dock module, if it is active.

opportunityAttacks.Name: Opportunity attack prompts
opportunityAttacks.Hint: When an enemy leaves a square adjacent to a creature without shifting, or makes a ranged/area attack next to it, whisper a chat card to that creature's controller with a button for the opportunity attack.

autoMoveActions.Name: Moving a token spends move actions
autoMoveActions.Hint: On a combatant's own turn, dragging its token spends a move action (walk speed per move action, shift speed for shifts; standard actions are traded when needed). Teleports, undo, charges and GM-dragged player tokens are ignored.

reactionPrompts.Name: Triggered power prompts
reactionPrompts.Hint: Offer powers with a Trigger (Elven Accuracy, Fox's Cunning, Furious Assault, Swift Charge, Infernal Wrath, and any power or monster power with a similar trigger) as a whispered chat card when the trigger happens.

damageTargets.Name: Apply damage to the attack's targets
damageTargets.Hint: Damage cards get buttons that apply damage to the targets of the original attack (players' clicks are applied by the GM), to the selected tokens, and a Retarget button.

powerRiders.Name: Power riders on hit
powerRiders.Hint: Apply Vicious Mockery, Dreadful Word, Curse of the Dark Dream and Stirring Shout to hit targets (with attack/defense penalties), heal allies who hit a Stirring Shout target, and offer Great Cleave's extra damage.

primeShot.Name: Prime Shot
primeShot.Hint: +1 to ranged attack rolls for characters with Prime Shot when no ally is nearer to the target.

tempHpFeatures.Name: Temporary HP features
tempHpFeatures.Hint: Rageblood Vigor (automatic when your attack drops an enemy), Half-Orc Resilience (automatic the first time you are bloodied in an encounter) and Virtue of Valor (card for the bard when an ally within 5 squares bloodies or drops an enemy).

classFeatures.Name: Class, racial and feat rules
classFeatures.Hint: Bloodhunt (+1 racial vs bloodied foes), Defensive Mobility (+2 AC vs opportunity attacks), Shadow Walk (concealment after moving 3 squares), Rampage (free melee basic attack after a critical hit) and Words of Friendship (+5 to the next Diplomacy check).

sheetModHighlights.Name: Highlight modified defences on sheets
sheetModHighlights.Hint: Colour defences changed by temporary effects (red = penalty, green = bonus) and list the effects in their tooltip.

readableRolls.Name: Readable roll breakdowns in chat
readableRolls.Hint: Replace the roll variables in chat (@wepAttack, @powerMod...) with labels and values, and show the module's automatic modifiers.

conditionalRiders.Name: Conditional damage and roll riders
conditionalRiders.Hint: Infernal Wrath rolls its fire damage; Dire Radiance deals its extra damage when the target moves closer; Elven Accuracy rerolls your last attack; Fox's Cunning and Fate of the Void add their bonus to the next attack.

clickMovement.Name: Click-to-move squares
clickMovement.Hint: Highlight the squares for shifts and push / pull / slide, then click to move. Hit riders open automatically after the roll; skipping leaves a button in chat.

powerLevels.Name: Automation and translation symbols
powerLevels.Hint: Show the ◆ automation and ■ translation level next to power names in sheets and chat cards. The GM can click a symbol to set it.

Effect.CurseDesc: {source}'s Warlock's Curse. Lasts until the end of the encounter or until this creature drops to 0 hit points.

Damage.FuriousAssaultHint: Extra damage from Furious Assault (1[W] for weapon attacks, 1d8 otherwise).

TextOverrides.Invalid: Invalid file: not a monster text file.
